You know that feeling when every path forward feels like the wrong one, right up until you’ve committed to it?
I think between all the chasing, the next business, the next place, the next version of myself I forgot you’re not actually supposed to find the thing by searching harder. I kept climbing mountains just to turn around halfway, sure I’d picked wrong.

But what if that certainty never comes? What if you only ever know by staying on one path long enough to see where it goes? Questions over questions

The King of the Arctic 🐻‍❄️🥶 
Los sueños se hacen realidad, poder encontrarme cara a cara con el mayor depredador terrestre del planeta, el oso polar, ha sido uno de los momentos más especiales de mi vida.

Verlo tan cerca, observar cada uno de sus movimientos durante tanto tiempo y disfrutar de este encuentro en plena naturaleza ha sido un auténtico sueño hecho realidad. No todos los días puedes contemplar a un animal tan increíble en su hábitat natural, rodeado por los paisajes únicos del océano Ártico y soportando uno de los climas más extremos de la Tierra.

Y esto es solo el principio de una aventura inolvidable. En los próximos días os enseñaré todo lo que he vivido en este rincón tan remoto del planeta 💙🙏🐻‍❄️

#PolarBear #Arctic #Wildlife

Hi & welcome if your new here 👋🏽✨ I’m Saxon a 24 year old creative & storyteller & I think it’s about time I give a little introduction. 

I was born & raised in a cozy small beach town in Australia, it’s called Byron Bay. I’ve been taking photos & crating since I was around 12 years old. I’m highly passionate about capturing life from my perspective & I love to write/read inspiring words. 📸📝

Over the years my work has evolved from landscape photos, marine life, people, sunsets, quotes & id like to say it’s now in a place of all combined which is quite special. 
When did you discover my work? Let me know ?

Why I create? 
I will create no doubt for the rest of my life, it’s my passion & I’m blessed to have been doing it most my life so far! 🦋
Recently I’ve had quite a bit of success over here on instagram which has been humbling & exiting. 
But behind the scenes the work can be time consuming & tiring. Until I started receiving beautiful messages from you guys. Hearing how much these posts have had a positive impact on your days truly fills my heart 🫀 
So I’m at this beautiful stage in my life where I feel a pull inwards to create inspiration & post that inspire me most & or make me question life the most & then share with you guys. 

I hope this posts reaches you well & I would love for you to know how much appreciate you all for choosing to follow & view my work. This is mostly the “why” in what I do now ♾️ 
With that said, I came up with the beautiful idea recently to start my letter club, where once a month I send you a postcard, a story & a gift. Sharing a letter of inspiration that you can slow down with/be preset & find inspiration off of your phone <3
If this speaks to you comment “soulful” & I’ll DM you more info.

Once again, thank you 😊 your support has truly changed my life & I look forward to continuing to bring inspiration to your days ⏳

Big love
Saxon 🤍

Такси без водителя, кофе от робота, лыжи посреди субтропиков, художники целыми улицами и музей, где я на несколько минут реально почувствовал себя внутри Jurassic Park 🦖

Чем больше бываю в Китае, тем сложнее меня удивить. Но Шэньчжэню опять удалось.

In den Dolomiten von Tirol

Frames of the Dolomites
The older I get, the more I realize it’s never really about the destination. It’s about the people you get to experience it with. 
Shot on @djiglobal Osmo Pocket 3 

There are places that look beautiful in photos. And then there are the Dolomites, which somehow look even better in real life.

You spend hours hiking for a view that only lasts a few minutes. Somehow, that’s exactly what makes it worth it.

Standing in front of mountains like these reminds you how small your problems actually are.

No notifications. No distractions. Just fresh air, good conversations, and endless peaks.

It’s funny how the places that make you feel the smallest often make you feel the most alive.

Maybe that’s why I keep coming back to the mountains. They don’t change who you are. They simply remind you of who you’ve been all along.

“Special occasions may stand out, but there’s nothing so precious as the quiet days between them.”
